market.structuralNote: e-3W sales hit 699,073 units in FY2025 (+11% YoY), now 57% of all three-wheeler sales in India — a real, fast electrification wave.
market.domesticSlice: figures are India-specific; this is a domestic-demand story, not an export one

structureFacts: Retrofit kits specifically are a narrow, largely UNCOUNTED slice of the broader electric three-wheeler market — most market-sizing research explicitly excludes 'kit retrofits, e-carts confined to private campuses, and prototypes not yet homologated' and focuses on purpose-built EVs instead. This means the large headline market figures above overstate the retrofit-specific opportunity.
North India currently dominates electric three-wheeler market share, driven by urbanization and policy support — the retrofit segment's own regional distribution is less documented.

adoptionStructure.note: Demand is driven by individual driver economics (fuel cost savings vs. kit cost + payback period), not a subscription/replacement-rate pattern.

peers.name: RACEnergy
peers.note: A close product/business-model comparable — battery-swap 3W retrofit kit priced around ₹50,000, claims 40-50% running-cost savings and a 12-15 month payback with ~100km range per swap. No financials found, but a useful benchmark for the kind of concrete, provable economic claim a retrofit company can lead with.

peers.name: GoGreenBOV
peers.note: 2W/3W/4W retrofit, batteries, charging, after-sales — no financials found.

peers.name: GOGOA1
peers.note: 46 approved 2W conversion models; actively developing 3W kits — no financials found.

peers.name: doReal Motors
peers.note: Battery retrofitting for 2W/3W/4W, also serves OEMs — no financials found.

drivers: Operating-cost savings (fuel vs. electric) and a short, provable payback period — RACEnergy's 12-15 month claim is the kind of concrete number this segment's buyers respond to.
RTO-legal re-registration and insurance eligibility, which depends on the retrofit kit holding real ARAI type approval — a regulatory gate, not just a technical one.
Installation speed/downtime (a driver's vehicle is their income; less downtime to convert matters directly).
customerValue.strongestPredictor: A concrete, provable payback period and confirmed RTO/ARAI legality — trust in the specific economic claim, more than brand or scale claims.

steps: quote against the retrofit kit spec and price
win via RTO-legal ARAI type-approval status
design/engineer the retrofit kit (battery, motor, charging)
demand arises from driver operating-cost pressure
recurring revenue via kit sale + battery lease (claimed model)
